description: Procurement of 3,000,000 inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) of 0.5ml/1ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 3,000,000 inactivated doses of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) 0.5 ml/1 ml, which is used for the prevention of rabies. Four bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendations of the High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Citihealth Imports (Pvt) Ltd. (Manufacturer: Serum Institute of India Pvt. Ltd., India) of Sri Lanka, for a total cost of Rs.360 million (excluding VAT), was approved by the Cabinet.
